summary: The screen that closes a period (請求締切, 支払締切, 月次の締め処理): the period, the targets with their state, and the closing with its release.
not_for: A list of records with no closing run (collection.table.index), or the entry of one document (entry.slip).

slots.when: Records in the period stand in the way of the closing.
A closed period can be opened again, by the roles that may do it.

rules.rule: The screen states the period it closes, and lists what the closing covers with the state of each target.
Where records in the period stand in the way (an unapproved slip, a document still being written), the screen says how many and links to them, and the closing waits.
A message asks before the closing runs, and states what the closing covers.
A closed period takes no edit and no deletion of its records, and the screen shows the period as closed.
Where a closing can be released, the release sits on the closed period; where it cannot, the confirmation says so before the run.
Amounts are aligned to the end, in tabular figures.

maps_to.shadcn: Table with a form of conditions

evidence.source: 弥生販売 サポート情報, 請求締切の操作手順
evidence.says: Before the closing runs, a message states what it covers and ends with よろしいですか.

evidence.source: 弥生販売 サポート情報, 支払締切(支払額の確定)
evidence.says: After a closing, the slips of the closed period can be neither edited nor deleted until the closing is cancelled; unapproved slips in the period block the closing; a toolbar action gathers the suppliers that meet the conditions.

evidence.source: freee ヘルプセンター, 【企業ユーザー】締め処理機能を利用する
evidence.says: The closing runs per period from the 締め処理 screen. Where invoices do not meet the closing condition, the screen shows their count with a way to their list. 仮締め locks the period for most users and can be released with [仮締め解除] by two roles; 本締め follows an OK click and cannot be released.

evidence.source: OBC 商蔵奉行iクラウド, 請求管理
evidence.says: The billing closing totals the sales and the receipts of a billing period, warns of overlapping or unbilled periods, and guards the slips of a closed period against edits and deletions.

evidence.source: Microsoft Learn, Business Central, Close accounting periods
evidence.says: The Close Year action shows a message that names the year and what the closing does, and closes on Yes; afterwards the periods are marked closed and locked, and the year cannot be opened again.
